newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Annan to visit India, Geneva, Italy, Germany.
newsitem.headline: Annan to visit India, Geneva, Italy, Germany.

text.p: Secretary-General Kofi Annan, who returns to New York later this week from an African tour, leaves next week for visits to India, Switzerland, Italy, the Vatican and Germany, a U.N. spokesman said on Monday.
Details of his itinerary have not yet been made public. He will first fly to New Delhi to address foreign ministers of the 113-member non-aligned movement and pay an official visit to India.
He then travels to Geneva for meetings before paying an official visit to Italy, where he inaugurates a U.N. staff college in Turin April 12 and has an audience with Pope John Paul II at the Vatican.
During his official visit to Germany Annan will meet President Roman Herzog, Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel.
